newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Man wounded in Moscow bomb attack - agency.
newsitem.headline: Man wounded in Moscow bomb attack - agency.

text.p: A man was seriously injured when a bomb exploded in the stairwell of a Moscow apartment block late on Wednesday night, Interfax news agency reported on Thursday.

The agency said the apartment block was on Rublovskoye Shossee, a major road used by state officials travelling between their country houses and the capital. The identity of the man was not immediately clear.
Interfax earlier reported that the man had died of his wounds.

Businessmen, especially bankers, have been the targets of a number of attacks in recent years. On Monday, an explosion damaged the car of a senior Finance Ministry official parked close to the Kremlin but no one was hurt.
